## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `CRITERION_HINT` tells authors to leave out "shall", but the `require_shall=True` validator mode this pull request keeps rejects exactly those criteria, so the hint text needs fixing before merge.

## Changes
The pull request rewords `CRITERION_HINT` and `BULLET_HINT` in `app/criteria.py`. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make the hint consistent with require_shall mode — With `require_shall: true`, a user who follows the new hint and writes `- Save the result` is rejected, because `accepts_criterion` returns `" shall " in text` at `app/criteria.py:8`. `tests/test_criteria.py:21` confirms that this exact input fails in that mode. — Deployments that enable `require_shall` would show a hint that leads users into validation failures. — Fix: Choose the hint based on `require_shall`, or reword it so it does not forbid "shall" in every mode.

## Suggestions
- review.txt:1 — correctness — Remove the unrelated review.txt file — The diff adds `review.txt` at the repository root. It has a single line addressed to a reviewer, no code references it, and the pull-request description does not mention it. — The file would ship as a stray root-level artifact that has nothing to do with the criteria hints.
